question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. **

PRODUCE (verb)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Destroy**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Produce means to make something or bring something into existence.

 
 
• Example - *France **produces **a great deal of wine for export.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Destroy means to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or no longer exists.
 
• Example - *The building was **destroyed **by fire.*
 
• It is clear that 'Produce' and 'Destroy' are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arrange **means to put something in order or in a particular pattern.
 
• **Yield **means to supply or produce something positive such as a profit, an amount of food, or information.
 
• **Harvest **means the time of year when crops are ripe and ready to be gathered.
